name: tau-banking-required-01

lines.fact: Record observed facts and values, who or what they refer to, and limits of the evidence.
lines.episode: Recount the situation, actions, and observed responses or outcomes in chronological order.
lines.procedure: Describe an ordered procedure, including when to verify a condition or stop. Identify steps whose validity is uncertain.
lines.lesson: State an evidence-supported lesson or caution and the conditions under which it applies.
lines.free: Choose how to organize useful observations from this experience. You may combine forms.

reader_admission: Before any reader of a task, verify all five sealed writers against the same source run, source journal and public experience hash. A writer must commit a nonempty item. A missing form blocks all ten consultations for that task.
analysis: Use the four original first passes and the required writers/readers only for policy outcomes. The optional pilot is a storage diagnostic with its own ledger. Compare preload and on-demand on the same bank. More or fewer searches alone cannot establish success or causation. Writing and solving charges remain separately accountable.
